description: This is a PHP test class for the EmpEmergencyContactDao, testing CRUD operations and search functionalities for employee emergency contact data within an HR management system.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for EmpEmergencyContactDao, testing CRUD operations and search features related to employee emergency contacts.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee emergency contact and verifies the data persistence.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEmergencyContactWithSeqNo
methods.description: Tests saving an emergency contact with a specific sequence number.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEmergencyContactWithInvalidSeqNo
methods.description: Verifies that saving an emergency contact with an invalid sequence number throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEmergencyContactList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the list of emergency contacts for an employee.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific emergency contact by employee ID and sequence number.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple emergency contacts for an employee.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Tests searching emergency contacts with specific filters.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsWithLimit
methods.description: Tests search with a limit on the number of results.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of emergency contacts matching search filters.
